CAT FISHER
CR 1/2

This wildcat lands lightly and folds its wings while watching you intently.

XP 200
N Tiny magical beast
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 size)
hp 11 (2d10)
Fort +3, Ref +6, Will +3

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 80 ft. (average)
Melee bite +5 (1d3-2) and 2 claws +5 (1d2-2)

STATISTICS

Str 6, Dex 17, Con 11, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 7
Base Attack +2; CMB -1; CMD 11 (15 vs. trip)
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Fly +11, Perception +2 (+5 for sight-based), Stealth +16, Survival +2; Racial Modifiers +3 Perception on sight-based checks, +4 Stealth
SQ sound mimicry (any)

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and hot plains
Organization solitary, pair, or pack (3–12)
Treasure none

The cat fisher is an interesting predator.

It is the size of a house cat, but is an amalgam of a hawk and a small wild cat.

The thing that really sets the cat fisher apart is its ability to mimic sounds of any kind with an uncanny clarity. They typically use this for distracting their prey while hunting. Certain nefarious folks have trained these creatures to distract other creatures.
